description: New York State Assemblyman Matt Slater (R,C-Yorktown) was honored with the Helene Goebbels Award during the Putnam Valley Volunteer Ambulance Corps’ (PVVAC) 65th Anniversary Dinner. Slater joined members of the Corps, community leaders and supporters in celebrating the organization’s 65 years of service to Putnam Valley.The award is named in honor of Helene Goebbels, whose generosity played an important role in the history of PVVAC.
